headline: Approved rent increases of $174.89 per month at 341 Cumberland Ave and $179.36 at 56 Federal St; tabled 439 Congress St request.
summary: Approved rent increases for 56 Federal St and 341 Cumberland Ave. Set the 2025 base rent for 24 Rowe Ave. Tabled the rent increase application for 439 Congress St until the next scheduled meeting.
decisions: Approved the August 19, 2026 and August 26, 2026 minutes, 5-0.
Approved the Findings of Fact and Conclusions of Law for 22 Grafton Street, units 22 and 24, 5-0.
Approved the Findings of Fact and Conclusions of Law for 76 William, all three units, 5-0.
Approved the Findings of Fact and Conclusions of Law for 132 Marginal Way, all 196 units, 5-0.
Approved rent increase of $179.36 for 56 Federal St, Unit 56-2, 5-0.
Established the 2025 base rent at $1850 for unit 1 and $1,332.50 for unit 2 at 24 Rowe Ave, 5-0.
Approved rent increase of $174.89 per month for 341 Cumberland Ave, all 29 units, 5-0.
Tabled the rent increase application for 439 Congress St to the next regularly scheduled meeting, 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: 0:01:50 - Anne-Laure Razat moves to approve the August 19, 2026 and August 26, 2026 Rent Board minutes. Seconded by Kristen Carreras. (5-0; James “Gordon” Platt absent). The motion passes.
0:05:15 - Anne-Laure Razat moves to approve the Findings of Fact & Conclusion of Law for 22 Grafton Street, units 22 and 24. Seconded by Kristen Carreras. (5-0; Platt absent) The motion passes.
0:06:30 - Kristen Carreras moves to approve the Findings of Fact & Conclusion of Law for 76 William, all three units. Seconded by Matthew Lax. (5-0; Platt absent) The motion passes.
0:07:24 - Kristen Carreras moves to approve the Findings of Fact & Conclusion of Law for 132 Marginal Way, all 196 units. Seconded by Anne-Laure Razat. (5-0; Platt absent) The motion passes.
0:22:31 - Kristen Carreras moves to approve 56 Federal St, Unit 56-2 in the amount of $179.36. Seconded by Anne-Laure Razat. (5-0; Platt absent) The motion passes.

1:27:10 - Anne-Laure Razat moves to establish the 2025 Base Rent is $1850 for unit 1 and $1,332.50 for unit 2 with an Allowable Increase Percentage of $114.51 per unit per month based on the MNOI calculations. Seconded by Jonas Burke. (5-0; Platt absent) The motion passes.
1:37:09 - Kristen Carreras moves to approve 341 Cumberland Ave, all 29 units, in the amount of $174.89 per month. Seconded by Matthew Lax. (5-0; Platt absent) The motion passes.

1:56:59 - Matthew Lax moves to table the application for 439 Congress to the next regularly scheduled meeting so that the applicant can provide some details on security costs and legal costs. Seconded by Jonas Burke. (5-0; Platt absent) The motion passes.
